subject: general-gk
note: Facets follow each bullet's own commas. The PYQ sample for this subject is noisier than others — it mixes in rows that belong to other exams' science sections or to the separate `reasoning` subject (क्रेब्स साइकिल, कूटलेखन, वेन आरेख); those were excluded rather than taxonomized here. Genuinely recurring on-syllabus categories not spelled out in the bullets (Government of India Acts sequence, Constituent Assembly committees, Article-to-topic mapping, important-day-to-date pairs) were added from the sample plus standard civics/history knowledge. Bullets 23-24 (समसामयिक घटनाएँ) carry only structural/evergreen leaves per instruction — no current-affairs pass yet.
